thread:
Ellen (docs): i ran a quick sweep of the dedicated provisioning guide and noticed inconsistent names: 'eviction_tolerance' in the CLI examples, 'eviction-window' in the yaml snippets, and 'preempt_grace' in older SDK examples. customers will be confused.
Tom (eng-runtime): bleh. that sounds like three different sprints' worth of naming. which files exactly?
Ellen (docs): found them in /docs/dedicated/provisioning.md (CLI quickstart), /docs/examples/reserved-pool.yaml, and the SDK snippets under /docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md.
Priya (sdk): the canonical field in the runtime API is now eviction_window_seconds and the SDK maps eviction_tolerance -> eviction_window_seconds for backwards compat. older helpers used preempt_grace.
Marta (prod): can we unify examples to use the runtime canonical name? i prefer docs showing the stable API. also we should add a short compatibility note for users on older SDKs.
Ellen (docs): agreed. i'll update the docs to use eviction_window_seconds everywhere and add a callout: "Note: older tooling may show eviction_tolerance or preempt_grace; map to eviction_window_seconds."
Tom (eng-runtime): also flagging that the CLI redwoodctl accepts --eviction-window as a flag now. we should update the CLI quickstart snippet.
Priya (sdk): i'll prepare a tiny SDK snippet replacement for both python and go. here's the python example i'll drop in:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_reserved_pool(region="eu-west-1", capacity=4, eviction_window_seconds=45)
```
Priya (sdk): and a Go example for the SDK page:
```go
client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient()
_, err := client.CreateReservedPool(ctx, redwood.CreatePoolParams{
  Region: "eu-west-1",
  Capacity: 4,
  EvictionWindowSeconds: 45,
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```
Ellen (docs): nice. i'll also change the YAML sample to the new name and add a one-line migration table mapping old->new names.
Marta (prod): one more ask: the SLA matrix still uses the column 'preemption-risk'. can we standardize that to 'eviction-risk' and add a tooltip explaining it's a relative risk metric not an absolute guarantee?
Ellen (docs): yup i'll update the table and tooltip copy: "Eviction-risk: relative likelihood of tenant eviction under system pressure; see SLO fallback policies for exact behavior."
Tom (eng-runtime): FYI infra clarified that eviction_window_seconds only affects soft-evictions (ordered throttling) and does not change hard preemption thresholds. maybe add that sentence under the eviction docs.
Ellen (docs): good catch. adding: "eviction_window_seconds controls soft-eviction grace windows; hard preemption is governed by cluster policies and SLA tier."
Priya (sdk): i'll add a short compatibility note above the snippets: "SDKs < v0.9.0 accept eviction_tolerance; the SDK maps it to eviction_window_seconds. Upgrade recommended."
Ellen (docs): drafting PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/524 (branch: docs/eviction-field-harmonize). includes python/go snippet swaps, YAML sample update, SLA table rename, and migration mapping. requesting quick reviews from @Tom and @Marta.
docs-bot: preview build: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/524 (validator warning: examples/reserved-pool.yaml uses unknown field 'preempt_grace' at line 9).
Ellen (docs): thanks bot i replaced preempt_grace in that file. please re-run preview.
Tom (eng-runtime): reviewed copy and the soft-eviction sentence. lgtm.
Marta (prod): checked SLA table rename and tooltip. lgtm. one UX nit: can we add a one-line example showing interplay between eviction_window_seconds and burst_window in the autoscale doc? customers ask about the timing semantics.
Priya (sdk): suggested sentence: "If burst_window < eviction_window_seconds, burst activity may be cut short by eviction heuristics; tune burst_window to allow expected burst duration."
Ellen (docs): adding that under autoscale tuning and cross-linking to the provisioning page. also adding a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md describing the eviction field harmonization and SDK mapping.
Priya (sdk): i pushed the snippet commits to the branch. PR updated.
Ellen (docs): merged after approvals. published. closing thread. thanks everyone! :tada:
